Name: AT - Slightly Recolored Iridium Sprinklers
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=5]Information:[/size]

This mod adds a variety of colors to the iridium sprinkler using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]'s new framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. 

Placing the sprinkler will randomly pick one of the colors, however, if you'd like to set a specific color to your sprinklers, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the sprinkler while equipping the bucket and pick the color of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki on it [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. 

[size=5]Installation: [/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! 

[size=5]Extra:[/size]
[size=3]
[/size]
-For issues with MY sprinklers, please report them to me, not to PeacefulEnd. If it's an issue with the framework itself, you can report them to PeacefulEnd [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=posts]here[/url] as long as you provide a log. 

-The sprinkler will have the vanilla look when it's in your inventory, it'll change once you put it on the ground. 

-There are currently no plans to add retextures to the quality sprinkler or the normal one.
